type.description: An ontology class id -- "recommendation", "terminology-code". Membership is checked at tier 2 against ontology/l1.json; this only rules out ids that could never be one.

label.description: Human-readable name. Required so a retrieved node reads without resolving it.

definedBy.description: Canonical URL of the smart-base logical model giving this node's instance shape, where the class has one. Ten of the nineteen concepts have none; those carry an id, a label and their edges, and nothing about their contents can be validated.

properties.description: Instance fields. The permitted keys per class are declared on the class in ontology/l1.json and checked at tier 2; nothing is asserted about them here.

derivation.description: Identical to traceability-link.schema.json, deliberately. derived: mechanically produced, no choice involved. inferred: a rule that could reasonably have gone another way. decided: the source is silent and someone chose. Every node and edge in a graph is one of the three, and the third is the one a reviewer needs to find.

location.description: file:line, a spreadsheet sheet and cell, or a BPMN element id.

artifact.description: The generated artifact affected, where one exists.

by.description: Who made the judgement. Required by tier 2 when derivation is decided: a person's choice between candidates is only reviewable if it says whose it was.

at.description: When the judgement was made. Required by tier 2 when derivation is decided.

evidence.description: Where this came from in the DAK. Required on anything not mechanically derived, for the same reason a failing check must quote its source: an assertion with nothing to point at is the confident wrong answer the package exists to prevent.

flagRef.description: Id of a flag raised while extracting this node. The flag itself lives in the extracting skill's validation report, not in the graph: a graph records what it found and what it had to decide, and routing an open question to its owner is the authoring pipeline's job.

skill.description: Skill id that produced this node.

title: NodeSchema
description: Generated from `NodeSchema` in L1/schemas/graph.ts, which is authoritative. Published because it is an exported Zod `*Schema` (owner ruling 2026-10-05) — which says it is reachable, not that it is stable.
